SML.Title: Sephral’s Module Loadouts
SML.Settings.Menu.Name: Sephral’s Module Loadouts
SML.Settings.Menu.Label: Open Loadout Manager
SML.Settings.Menu.Hint: Save, compare, apply, export, and import module activation profiles for this world or for your whole installation.
SML.Settings.Language.Name: Language
SML.Settings.Language.Hint: Choose whether Module Loadouts follows Foundry or uses a fixed module language.
SML.Settings.Theme.Name: Manager design
SML.Settings.Theme.Hint: Choose whether the loadout manager uses the Signature look or a Foundry-style appearance.
SML.Settings.CheckDisplay.Name: Check after restart
SML.Settings.CheckDisplay.Hint: After a loadout is applied, the next start checks whether all its modules are active and started without errors. Problems always open a window. Choose whether a clean result opens one too or only shows a short notice.
SML.Manager.ControlsHint: Save the current state, pin modules, hunt a bug or move loadouts in and out as JSON.
SML.Manager.PermissionWarning: Only users with module management permission can change or apply loadouts.
SML.Manager.AvailabilityBlocked: package is not compatible with this world
SML.Manager.AvailabilityWarning: package is not fully verified for this environment
SML.Manager.EmptyBody: Save the current module state to create your first reusable module loadout.
SML.Manager.AutoHint: Saved automatically before a loadout was applied. Only the last {count} are kept. Edit or duplicate it to keep it for good.
SML.Filter.Empty: No loadout matches the current filter.
SML.Dialog.SaveCurrent.Title: Save Current Module Loadout
SML.Dialog.Profile.Name: Profile name
SML.Dialog.Edit.Title: Edit Module Loadout '{name}'
SML.Dialog.Duplicate.Title: Duplicate Module Loadout '{name}'
SML.Dialog.Replace.Title: Replace Existing Profile
SML.Dialog.Replace.Content: A profile named '{name}' already exists. Replace it with the current active module state?
SML.Dialog.Delete.Title: Delete Module Loadout
SML.Dialog.Preflight.Title: Apply Loadout '{name}'
SML.Dialog.ConfirmApply.Snapshot: Your current modules and settings are saved as an automatic snapshot first, so you can switch back.
SML.Snapshot.Name: Before apply ({date})
SML.Check.Title: Loadout check: {name}
SML.Check.AllGood: Loadout '{name}' applied: all {count} modules are active, no errors.
SML.Check.Problems: Loadout '{name}' was applied, but the start found problems.
SML.Check.Unexpected: Active but not part of the loadout:
SML.Check.UndoHint: Undo switches back to the modules that were active before.
SML.Check.UndoMissing: The automatic snapshot from before the switch no longer exists, so there is nothing to undo.
SML.Notification.NoChanges: The selected profile already matches the current active module configuration.
SML.Notification.MissingModules: These modules are referenced by the profile but are not installed here: {modules}.
SML.Notification.BlockingDependencies: Cannot apply this profile because required dependencies are missing or unavailable: {details}
SML.Notification.ManageModulesRequired: You do not have permission to manage module activation in this world.
SML.Notification.SnapshotSaved: Saved the previous module state as '{name}'.
SML.Notification.ProfileNotFound: No module loadout named '{name}' was found.
SML.Notification.NameTaken: A loadout named '{name}' already exists ({scope}). Choose another name.
SML.Import.Invalid: The selected file does not contain any valid module loadout profiles.
SML.Manager.Details.Changed: Updated since the loadout was saved
SML.Manager.Details.UnusedLibraries: Libraries no module of the loadout needs
SML.Dialog.Duplicate.Name: {name} Copy
SML.Dialog.Profile.SettingsAll: Modules and all their settings, hidden ones too
SML.Dialog.Profile.SettingsVisibleAgain: Save the settings again from this world
SML.Dialog.Profile.SettingsAllAgain: Save all settings again from this world, hidden ones too
SML.Dialog.Profile.SettingsHint: Saved settings are the world settings of the loadout's modules. Applying the loadout sets them again, also in another world. Hidden settings often hold a module's data, so only take them along when you know what they do.
SML.Dialog.ConfirmApply.Pinned: Pinned modules that stay as they are:
SML.Dialog.ConfirmApply.ChangedVersions: Updated since the loadout was saved:
SML.Dialog.Import.Title: Import Module Loadouts
SML.Dialog.Import.Intro: The file contains {count} loadout(s). Choose what happens with each of them.
SML.Dialog.Pinned.Title: Pinned Modules
SML.Dialog.Pinned.Intro: Applying a loadout leaves pinned modules as they are: an active one stays active, an inactive one stays off.
SML.Installation.Unavailable: The installation loadouts could not be read. They stay unchanged until the file can be read again.
SML.Installation.WriteFailed: The installation loadouts could not be saved to the user data.
SML.Installation.Migrated: Moved {count} installation loadout(s) of this browser into the user data. Every gamemaster and every browser of this installation sees them now.
SML.Check.HuntHint: Find the cause starts a bug hunt for the first error in this list.
SML.Hunt.Title: Bug Hunt
SML.Hunt.Intro: The bug hunt switches off half of the suspected modules per step and restarts the world, until one module is left. With {count} active modules that takes about {steps} restarts. Your modules come back at the end.
SML.Hunt.ReloadNote: Every step reloads the world for everyone who is connected.
SML.Hunt.ModeError: An error message. The hunt watches for it in every step.
SML.Hunt.PatternPlaceholder: Paste the error message or a part of it
SML.Hunt.ModeManual: Something else. I check every step myself.
SML.Hunt.KeepHint: They are on in every step and never suspected, for example modules you need to reproduce the problem. Pinned modules are ticked already.
SML.Hunt.PatternRequired: Enter the error message the hunt should look for.
SML.Hunt.NothingToSearch: There is no module to search: every active module stays on.
SML.Hunt.SnapshotDescription: Module state before the bug hunt.
SML.Hunt.Step.Baseline: First check: every suspected module is off. Only the modules that stay on run ({count}).
SML.Hunt.Step.Search: {tested} of {suspects} suspected modules are on in this step ({active} modules active).
SML.Hunt.Step.Verify: Last check: all your modules except {module}.
SML.Hunt.ManualHint: Try to reproduce the problem now, then answer.
SML.Hunt.Question: Is the problem still there?
SML.Hunt.Suggestion: The highlighted answer follows the error watch. Some errors only appear when you do something, so check before you answer.
SML.Hunt.StopConfirm: Stop the bug hunt and restore the modules from before it?
SML.Hunt.Result.Found: Found it: the problem comes from {module}. With all your other modules it is gone.
SML.Hunt.Result.NotModules: The problem is also there with every suspected module off. It most likely comes from Foundry, the game system, the world or a module that stayed on.
SML.Hunt.Result.Unclear: No single module could be found. Several modules may cause the problem only together.
SML.Hunt.Result.UnclearCandidate: The search ended at {module}, but without it the problem was still there. Several modules may cause it together.
SML.Hunt.Dependents: These modules need it and stay off as well: {modules}.
SML.Hunt.RestoreWithoutName: Modules before the bug hunt without {module}
SML.Notification.NoSettingsFound: The loadout's modules have no world settings to save.
SML.Notification.SettingsSkipped: {count} very large setting(s) were left out, they hold data rather than configuration.
SML.Notification.ManifestCopyFailed: Could not copy the manifest URL: {manifest}
SML.Notification.SettingsSecret: {count} setting(s) that look like a password or an access key were left out on purpose.
SML.SelfTest.Title: Module Loadouts self test
SML.SelfTest.Hint: Checks the module configuration, the hotkey, the button in Manage Modules, the settings in loadouts and the installation file without changing anything. Run it after an update of Foundry.
SML.SelfTest.Problems: Self test: {problems} of {checks} checks failed. See the chat message.
SML.SelfTest.NewVersions: Module Loadouts was verified with an older Foundry than {versions}. Run the self test in the module settings to check that everything still works.
SML.SelfTest.Configuration: Foundry's module configuration ({key}) cannot be read.
SML.SelfTest.Reload: Foundry's reload prompt was not found, so applying a loadout cannot ask for a reload.
SML.SelfTest.ModuleManagement: The Manage Modules window has changed, so its button for the loadouts may be missing.
SML.SelfTest.Hotkey: The hotkey Ctrl + Shift + L is not registered.
SML.SelfTest.Texts: The texts of the module are missing.
SML.SelfTest.CurrentLoadout: A loadout of the active modules would switch modules, so comparing loadouts gives wrong results.
SML.SelfTest.SettingsStorage: Foundry's storage of world settings has changed, so settings in loadouts can be neither saved nor applied.
SML.SelfTest.SettingsRoundTrip: Settings of the active modules would change when a loadout takes them along.
SML.SelfTest.InstallationRead: The installation loadouts cannot be read ({path}).
SML.SelfTest.InstallationUpload: Your role may not upload files, so installation loadouts cannot be saved.
SML.SelfTest.Permission: Your role may not configure modules, so you can look at the loadouts but not apply them.
